attBesluta.text: Todo ok Relación calidad precio muy buena y buena atención
Bought it for home use and it fits perfectly. Makes the whole setup look tidier. Better made than the price would suggest. Just what I was after.

These cable ramps will work great for what I needed them for. These cable ramps are not compatible with yellow jacket. They are very heavy and very flexible. They are very hard to handle with one person. If you do not have to move them and don't have another brand in inventory I am sure they will be great at the price. If you need a portable ADA ramp that a crew can carry this is not for you.

These are heavy and seem very durable, however after a few weeks of use, they are already damaged. The channel dividers are disintegrating, and the flaps that go over the cords are tearing at the hinges. When I reached out to Vevor for warranty/support I was told these issues don't affect the usage of the product and they wouldn't honor any warranty or replacement.
Looks like very good quality - looking forward to using
Item as described, arrived quickly, very satisfied.
Fantastic product, price and superfast delivery. Thank you.

Always wanted a ceramic smoker and was stoked to see that VEVOR sold one, purchased one on sale and immediately put it to use. It holds heat well and smokes excellently. I made smoked Lamb Shoulder, Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Beef Brisket 8 hours and it held heat that long without adding any charcoal
